title: Farmers launch indefinite protest and block roads demanding crop loan waivers in Tiruchirappalli
seoTitle: Tiruchi farmers block roads over loan waivers

tea.why: Protesting for full crop loan waivers and water release for samba paddy crops following election promises.
tea.want: Full waiver of crop loans, the release of 9,000 cusecs of Cauvery water, and livelihood relief.
tea.changed: Oct 21: Farmers blocked roads across multiple districts, leading to hundreds of arrests by police.

summary: Farmers affiliated with Left parties staged road-blocking demonstrations across Tiruchirappalli and surrounding districts in the central region, demanding a complete waiver of crop loans as previously promised by the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam ahead of the State Assembly elections. According to reports, the demonstrators also called on the State government to release 9,000 cusecs of Cauvery water to safeguard samba paddy crops and to provide compensation for affected families. The protests took place in locations such as Tiruverumbur, Lalgudi, and Manapparai, alongside actions in neighbouring districts including Pudukottai, Thanjavur, and Mayiladuthurai. Police intervened across the region, resulting in numerous arrests of participating farmers.
demands: Relief for families who lost their livelihood
response: Police arrested 170 persons in Tiruchi district, 119 in Pudukottai, over 500 in Thanjavur, and over 250 in Mayiladuthurai district following road-blocking agitations.

arrests.text: leading to the arrest of 170 persons in Tiruchi district

updates.text: Farmers blocked roads across Tiruchirappalli and other central districts, prompting widespread police arrests.
